slot_scores.name: purchase_beginning_of_month_timing
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about flow balance and monthly decisions but never explicitly asked whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month or whether purchased goods are available for sale in the same month.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases are available in the same month for the inventory balance and sales, without confirming the beginning-of-month purchase timing.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about purchase timing within the month, and the user simulator did not volunteer this fact; the READY_TO_MODEL summary assumes the standard same-month availability.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about beginning-of-month purchase timing remained unresolved.

summary: The agent asked several useful clarifying questions and explicitly deferred some uncertain points, but it missed the P1 purchase-timing slot and then stopped with that hidden fact unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
